name: minecraftbot-eva-agent
description: Autonomous embodied Minecraft AI agent powered by a local Qwen OpenAI-compatible endpoint

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/agent.js && node --check src/building.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/llm.js && node --check src/memory.js && node --check src/movement.js && node --check src/physical-builder.js && node --check src/reference-policy.js && node --check src/rcon.js && node --check src/world.js && node --check scripts/patch-protocol-776.js && node --check scripts/test-blueprints.js && node --check scripts/test-protocol-patch.js && node --check scripts/test-reference-policy.js
scripts.test: npm run test:blueprints && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:reference
scripts.verify:mineflayer: node -e "const v=require('mineflayer/package.json').version; if (!v.startsWith('4.37.1')) { console.error('Expected Mineflayer 4.37.1-based fork, got '+v); process.exit(1) } console.log('Mineflayer '+v+' OK')"
